description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom & Papper growing & Manufacturing Trade - January to April, 2020
reasoning: This gazette content contains a notification issued under the Wages Boards Ordinance (Chapter 136) regarding special allowances payable to workers in specific trades. It references statutory authority (Section 20(2)(b) of the Ordinance) and establishes regulatory requirements for wage adjustments based on cost of living index numbers. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it involves the implementation and notification of statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements.
